_how_to: public_endpoint: fixed public https base URL (e.g. a named Cloudflare tunnel), without /api/tip; takes precedence. quick_tunnel: true = run.sh keeps a Cloudflare quick tunnel watchdog running (tunnel.sh; random *.trycloudflare.com URL in tunnel-url.txt, cleared when down). tip_page_uses_server: true = the built /tip/ page posts to the tip server (URL read at runtime from /tip-endpoint.json, GitHub form as fallback); false = /tip/ keeps the GitHub issue form (env TIP_PAGE_SERVER=1 forces server mode for a local preview build). auto_publish_endpoint: true = tunnel.sh/run.sh push tip-endpoint.json to gh-pages whenever the URL changes; false = only site/tip-endpoint.json is updated locally. Set tip_page_uses_server and auto_publish_endpoint to true ONLY after jQrgen approves the tip page.
